metadata.title: CareConnect
metadata.description: Apne qareeb doctor dhoondein aur appointment book karein.

site.notificationsBlocked: Aap ke browser ki site settings mein band hain
site.notificationsError: Kuch ghalat ho gaya — dobara koshish karein

directory.heading: Doctor dhoondein
directory.heroSubtitle: Specialty, naam ya clinic se dhoondein — asal available waqt dekhein aur minton mein clinic visit book karein.
directory.trust1Body: Har profile live hone se pehle check aur license-verify ki jaati hai.
directory.trust2Body: Asal khaali slots dekhein — na andaaza, na baar baar phone calls.
directory.trust3Body: Confirm slot ke saath jaayein aur waiting room ki lambi line se bachein.
directory.empty: Is search ke liye koi doctor nahin mila.
directory.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {Koi result nahin} one {# result} other {# results}}

practitionerProfile.reviewEligibilityNote: Aap doctor ka review appointment par check in karne ke baad de sakte hain.
practitionerProfile.loginToReview: Review dene ke liye log in karein

auth.heading: Log in ya sign up karein
auth.subtitle: Apna phone number likhein, hum aap ko ek dafa ka code bhejenge
auth.phoneHint: Pakistani number 03 ya +92 se shuru ho sakte hain
auth.sentCodeTo: Hum ne {identifier} par code bhej diya hai
auth.error: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
auth.roleUsePatient: Yeh number ek mareez ke account ka hai. Is ki jagah "Mujhe doctor ki talaash hai" chunein.
auth.roleUseProvider: Yeh number ek doctor ke account ka hai. Is ki jagah "Main healthcare provider hoon" chunein.
auth.roleUseStaff: Yeh number ek receptionist ke account ka hai. Is ki jagah "Main clinic staff hoon" chunein.
auth.roleNotInvitedStaff: Abhi tak kisi clinic ne is number ko receptionist ke taur par shaamil nahin kiya. Apne clinic ke maalik se kahein ke woh apne Staff page se isi number par aap ko invite karein, phir dobara koshish karein.

patient.profileSaveError: Aap ki settings save nahin ho sakin. Dobara koshish karein.
patient.noFamilyMembers: Aap ne abhi tak ghar ka koi fard shaamil nahin kiya.
patient.noAppointments: Aap ki abhi koi appointment nahin.
patient.forFamilyMember: Ghar ke kisi fard ke liye
patient.noSlots: Is tareekh ke liye koi slot available nahin.
patient.joinWaitlist: Is tareekh ki waitlist mein shaamil hon
patient.noWaitlistEntries: Aap abhi kisi waitlist mein nahin hain.

clinic.noVitalsRecorded: Abhi tak koi vitals nahin likhe gaye.
clinic.noRecordsLinked: Abhi tak koi record upload nahin hua.
clinic.invitePrompt: Receptionist ya junior doctor ko phone number se invite karein. Invite ke baad woh isi number se CareConnect mein sign in karte hain. Junior doctor ke liye practitioner profile bhi zaroori hai.
clinic.inviteSuccess: Invite bhej diya — ab woh CareConnect mein log in kar sakte hain.
clinic.permissionsHeading: Role chunein aur dekhein ke woh kya kya kar sakta hai
clinic.permissionsToggleHeading: Jo kaam unhein nahin karna chahiye, woh band kar dein

permissions.viewPatientList: Mareezon ke naam, number aur visit ki tareekhein dekhna
permissions.viewTodayQueue: Aaj ki appointments ki line dekhna
permissions.viewRecords: Upload kiye gaye medical records dekhna
permissions.manageStaff: Staff ko invite ya remove karna

clinic.assignmentsPrompt: Junior doctor sirf woh mareez dekhta hai jo aap yahan us ke supurd karein — poori practice nahin.
clinic.noJuniorDoctors: Mareez supurd karne se pehle oopar kisi active junior doctor ko invite karein.
clinic.noAssignments: Abhi tak koi mareez supurd nahin kiya gaya.
clinic.reviewedAllergiesLabel: Main ne yeh nuskha oopar di gayi allergies ke muqable mein check kar liya hai.
clinic.reviewedNoAllergiesLabel: Main ne nuskha likhne se pehle is mareez ka allergy record check kar liya hai.
clinic.allergyWarningBody: {drugs} is mareez ki allergy list ki kisi cheez se mil sakti hai — yeh sirf alfaaz ka milaan hai, clinical interaction check nahin, is liye apni samajh se faisla karein.
clinic.accessDenied: Aap ko is page tak rasaai nahin.
clinic.revenueDisclaimer: Visits × har doctor ki maujooda consultation fee — yeh asal mein wasool hui raqam ka record nahin. CareConnect payments process nahin karta.
clinic.noActivityYet: Is muddat mein abhi tak koi appointment nahin.
clinic.reviewsPrompt: Un mareezon ke reviews jin ka aap ne ilaaj kiya. Jo review usoolon ke khilaf ho, use report karein taa ke admin dekh sake.
clinic.reportReasonLabel: Aap yeh review kyun report kar rahe hain?
clinic.attachRecordPrompt: Use us visit ke saath milayein jis ki yeh hai, sirf naam se nahin — jab do mareezon ka naam ek ho to yeh mehfooz hai.
clinic.verificationScopeNote: Woh documents upload karein jo admin ko aap ki verification ke liye chahiye — aap ka CNIC, degree aur council registration certificate.
clinic.noDocumentsYet: Abhi tak koi document upload nahin hua.

workingHours.heading: Kaam ke auqaat
workingHours.intro: Mareez sirf wohi waqt book kar sakte hain jo aap yahan rakhein. Inhi auqaat se slots khud ban jaate hain.
workingHours.ownerOnly: Sirf clinic ka maalik kaam ke auqaat rakh sakta hai.
workingHours.notSetTitle: Mareez abhi aap se booking nahin kar sakte
workingHours.notSetBody: Aap ne is clinic ke kaam ke auqaat save nahin kiye, is liye aap directory mein nazar nahin aate. Neeche auqaat dekhein, apni fee likhein aur Save dabayein.
workingHours.setUpLink: Apne kaam ke auqaat rakhein taa ke mareez aap se booking kar sakein →
workingHours.saved: Kaam ke auqaat save ho gaye. Mareez ab yeh waqt book kar sakte hain.
workingHours.feeHint: Booking se pehle mareezon ko dikhayi jaati hai.
workingHours.slotLengthHint: Har din ke auqaat isi dauraniye ke slots mein taqseem hote hain.
workingHours.dailyCapHint: Itni bookings ho jaane par us din ki booking band ho jaayegi. Koi had na ho to khaali chhor dein.
workingHours.cancellationHint: Mareez appointment se itne ghante pehle tak online cancel kar sakte hain.
workingHours.activeHint: Auqaat ganwaye baghair is clinic ki online booking rokne ke liye nishaan hata dein.
workingHours.weekHint: Pakistan time. Jin dinon aap mareez dekhte hain un par nishaan lagayein aur rozana do nashistein tak rakhein, masalan subah aur shaam. Doosri nashist ki zaroorat na ho to khaali chhor dein.
workingHours.errorHalfRange: {day}: shuru aur khatam dono ka waqt likhein, ya dono khaali karein.
workingHours.errorNoTimes: {day} khula chuna gaya hai lekin koi waqt nahin. Waqt shaamil karein ya din se nishaan hata dein.

vault.heading: Mere records
vault.empty: Aap ne abhi tak koi record shaamil nahin kiya.
vault.noMedicalSummary: Abhi tak koi allergy, beemari ya blood group darj nahin.
vault.shareHeading: Doosri raaye ke liye share karein
vault.durationForever: Jab tak main band na karoon
vault.mySharesHeading: Aap ke share kiye gaye links
vault.noShares: Aap ne abhi tak kuch share nahin kiya.
vault.shareOpenedCount: {count, plural, =0 {Kabhi nahin khola gaya} one {Ek dafa khola gaya} other {# dafa khola gaya}}

sharedRecord.heading: Share kiya gaya medical record
sharedRecord.invalidBody: Ho sakta hai is ki mudat khatam ho gayi ho ya mareez ne ise band kar diya ho.
sharedRecord.neverExpiresLabel: Yeh link tab tak khula rahega jab tak mareez ise band na kare
sharedRecord.noMedicalSummary: Koi allergy, beemari ya blood group darj nahin.
sharedRecord.noVisitHistory: Is share mein visits ki history shaamil nahin.
sharedRecord.noRecords: Is share mein koi record shaamil nahin.
sharedRecord.footerNote: CareConnect ke zariye sirf parhne ke liye share kiya gaya — is link ka khulna record kar liya gaya hai.

admin.heading: Doctors ki verification
admin.scopeNote: Doctor ki di gayi registration number aur tafseelaat check karein, saath hi neeche upload kiye gaye CNIC/degree/registration certificate documents bhi.
admin.accessDenied: Aap ko is page tak rasaai nahin.
admin.empty: Review ke liye kuch baaqi nahin.
admin.noDocuments: Abhi tak koi document upload nahin hua.
admin.reviewsScopeNote: Doctor apne bare mein kisi review ko report kar sakta hai; chhupane se woh public directory se hat jaata hai, delete nahin hota — yeh moderation ka *tareeqa* hai, is baat ki policy nahin ke kya report ho sakta hai (woh faisla abhi baaqi hai).

onboarding.roleHeading: Aap CareConnect kaise istemal karna chahenge?
onboarding.patientOptionDesc: Appointments book karein, apne ghar walon ke sehat ke records sambhalein, aur bohat kuch.
onboarding.practitionerOptionDesc: Apni practice register karein aur apne qareeb ke mareezon tak pohanchein.
onboarding.staffOptionDesc: Clinic ki taraf se invite kiye gaye receptionists.
onboarding.staffNote: Clinic staff? Aap khud sign up nahin kar sakte. Aap ka clinic maalik apne Staff page se aap ko shaamil karta hai, phir aap isi phone number se sign in karein aur "Main clinic staff hoon" chunein.
onboarding.practitionerHeading: Healthcare provider ke taur par register karein
onboarding.languagesLabel: Bolee jaane wali zubaanein (comma se alag)
onboarding.specialtiesRequired: Baraye meharbani kam az kam ek specialty chunein.
onboarding.error: Kuch ghalat ho gaya. Dobara koshish karein.
onboarding.becomeProviderLink: Is ki jagah healthcare provider ke taur par register karein
